risks.title: Litigation Risk - Asbestos Claims
risks.summary: Company faces significant asbestos litigation through Chapter 11 proceedings of subsidiaries. Estimated liability and case duration remain uncertain.
risks.description: Company faces significant asbestos litigation through Chapter 11 proceedings of subsidiaries. Estimated liability and case duration remain uncertain. Des dénouements défavorables alourdiraient les coûts juridiques et provisions.
risks.score_rationale_en: Aldrich and Murray subsidiaries filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2020 to address asbestos-related claims. A $270M qualified settlement fund was established in March 2022. First phase of liability estimation hearing scheduled for August 2026. Outcome remains uncertain and could have material financial impact. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "sales and marketing, business operations, supply chain, product management, innovation, technology, digital transformation and risk"

risks.title: Competitive and Technology Risk
risks.score_rationale: Rapid technological change, including AI, increases risk of product lifecycle shortening. Competition from alternative solutions and new market entrants could lead to decreased demand and reduced market share. Company must continuously innovate to maintain competitive position. Citation: "sales and marketing, business operations, supply chain, product management, innovation, technology, digital transformation and risk"
risks.summary: Company must innovate continuously to compete with emerging AI-driven solutions and alternative technologies in HVAC and building automation markets.
risks.description: Company must innovate continuously to compete with emerging AI-driven solutions and alternative technologies in HVAC and building automation markets. Cela peut éroder les parts de marché et limiter le pouvoir de fixation des prix.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Trade Policy Risk
risks.summary: Global trade policy changes including tariffs create supply chain challenges, commodity cost volatility, and economic uncertainty affecting operations and end markets.
risks.description: Global trade policy changes including tariffs create supply chain challenges, commodity cost volatility, and economic uncertainty affecting operations and end markets. Les tensions diplomatiques peuvent perturber chaînes d'approvisionnement et débouchés.
risks.score_rationale_en: Company operates globally and is exposed to tariff changes, trade policy uncertainty, and geopolitical disruptions. U.S. tariffs announced and implemented in 2025, with retaliatory measures from other countries, create supply chain and cost volatility risks. Company is monitoring dynamic global trade policy developments. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "sales and marketing, business operations, supply chain, product management, innovation, technology, digital transformation and risk"

risks.title: Market Demand and Macroeconomic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Residential markets weakened considerably in 2025 due to regulatory refrigerant transition and softer consumer demand. Transport refrigeration markets experience weaker demand. Asia shows mixed macro-economic conditions. Economic risks and higher interest rates create uncertainties. Citation: "market-sensitive framework that mitigates the risk of fixed targets becoming misaligned due to unforeseen economic"
risks.summary: Residential and transport refrigeration markets face headwinds from regulatory transitions, consumer demand softness, and macroeconomic uncertainties.
risks.description: Residential and transport refrigeration markets face headwinds from regulatory transitions, consumer demand softness, and macroeconomic uncertainties. Le contexte macro et sectoriel reste un facteur déterminant.

risks.title: AI Implementation and Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: AI presents emerging issues and pace of change creates uncertainties. Company may experience competitive harm, reputational harm, or legal liability from AI implementation. Risk of product failures or customer dissatisfaction with AI-driven solutions. Citation: "Technology and Innovation Committee Considers risks associated with technologies that can have a material impact"
risks.summary: AI integration in products and operations presents emerging risks including competitive disadvantage, reputational harm, and potential legal liability from AI failures.
risks.description: AI integration in products and operations presents emerging risks including competitive disadvantage, reputational harm, and potential legal liability from AI failures. Les ruptures technologiques imposent des investissements continus pour rester compétitif.

risks.title: Innovation and Talent Risk
risks.score_rationale: Successful innovation depends on attracting and retaining highly skilled talent in engineering, technology, and product management. Labor market constraints and increased competition for skilled professionals may delay innovation initiatives or increase costs. Citation: "sales and marketing, business operations, supply chain, product management, innovation, technology, digital transformation and risk"
risks.summary: Competition for skilled talent in engineering and AI domains could delay innovation and increase compensation costs, affecting competitiveness.
risks.description: Competition for skilled talent in engineering and AI domains could delay innovation and increase compensation costs, affecting competitiveness. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Regulatory and Sustainability Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company must comply with environmental and social regulations across multiple jurisdictions. Regulatory refrigerant transitions and environmental compliance requirements affect product development and market availability. Non-compliance could result in fines and operational restrictions. Citation: "not limited to, conflicts of interest, confidentiality of information and compliance with laws and regulations"
risks.summary: Environmental and social regulations, including refrigerant transitions, require product adaptations and create market volatility.
risks.description: Environmental and social regulations, including refrigerant transitions, require product adaptations and create market volatility. Une non-conformité ou un durcissement entraînerait coûts additionnels et restrictions.
